tagline: Specialty chemicals innovator focused on sustainable solutions for healthcare, nutrition, and industrial applications
hero_kpi_rationale: The adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.3% reflects Evonik's ability to generate solid operating profitability in a challenging environment, while maintaining stability amid competitive pressures and foreign exchange impacts. This is a key indicator of sustainable operational performance for a specialty chemicals company.
company_description: Evonik Industries AG operates as a chemicals company in the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas. It operates through the Advanced Technologies, Custom Solutions, and Infrastructure segments. The Advanced Technologies segment provides polymers for medical applications; crosslinkers; hydrogen peroxide, a sterilizing agent for cleaning silicon wafers and a bleaching agent for the paper and textile industries; fumed and precipitated silicas and silanes for the automotive, tire, electronics, and cosmetics industries; and D-/L-methionine and lysine for animal nutrition. Its Custom Solutions segment provides additives for coatings, adhesives, sealants, polyurethane foams, and lubricants for the cosmetic, cleaning, and pharmaceutical industries. The Infrastructure segment engages in the infrastructure activities and offers butadiene, MTBE, butene-1, isononanol, and DINP for use in the plastic and packaging industries, production of rubber and fuels, and as plasticizers in the construction and automotive sectors. The company was founded in 1847 and is headquartered in Essen, Germany.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, excluding non-recurring charges.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA for 2025 amounts to €1,874 million, in line with expectations, driven by cost savings and strong performance in the Health segment.
kpis.signal: Solid cash generation despite challenging environment

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted EBITDA divided by sales, measures operating profitability.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA margin slightly declined to 13.3% in 2025 from 13.6% in 2024, impacted by competition and foreign exchange effects.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after investments, key for financial flexibility.
kpis.description: FCF in 2025 reaches €695 million, with a conversion rate of 37%, in the upper half of guidance.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand operations.
kpis.description: Capex in 2025 amounts to €748 million, down from €840 million in 2024, reflecting increased budgetary discipline.
kpis.signal: Capex reduction aligned with rationalization strategy

kpis.name: Return on Capital Employed
kpis.explanation: Profitability generated on capital invested in the business.
kpis.description: ROCE in 2025 is stable at approximately 6.1%, with a clear strategy to improve it through growth projects and optimization programs.
kpis.signal: ROCE around 6.1% in 2025, target of 11% in the medium term

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Financial debt after deduction of available cash.
kpis.description: Net debt amounts to €3,311 million in 2025, a slight annual increase but down from €3,677 million at end-Q3.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in net debt, but lower since Q3

kpis.name: Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of net debt to EBITDA, measures debt repayment capacity.
kpis.description: Leverage ratio increases to 2.4x at end-2025 from 2.3x in 2024, still within a manageable range.
kpis.signal: Leverage up to 2.4x, but under control

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to shareholders per share held.
kpis.description: A dividend of €1.00 per share is proposed for 2025, transitioning to a payout ratio of 40-60% starting in 2026.
kpis.signal: New dividend policy with fixed €1.00 dividend for 2025

kpis.name: Total Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by the company.
kpis.description: Sales in 2025 amount to €14,069 million, down 7% vs 2024, primarily due to dollar weakness.
kpis.signal: Sales decline in 2025, impacted by FX

kpis.name: Custom Solutions Segment EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the segment specialized in customized chemical solutions.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA for the Custom Solutions segment reaches €909 million in 2025, driven by health, despite weak demand for commodity ingredients.
kpis.signal: Custom Solutions segment resilient despite weak demand

kpis.name: Advanced Technologies Segment EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the advanced technologies segment, including organic and inorganic businesses.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA for the Advanced Technologies segment stands at €944 million in 2025, down 8%, affected by methionine price normalization.

ai_positioning.summary: Evonik does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its recent financial documents. The company focuses on operational optimization, cost reduction, and growth in specialized niches.
evidence: No mention of AI or related technologies in the Q4/FY 2025 fact sheet
Priority given to optimization programs, working capital management, and organic growth projects
No references to AI in segments, innovations, or outlook
